description: Design the Contoso Ticketing Azure architecture.

# Inputs

- `docs/concepts/workload.md` — the requirement document.

# Task

Acting as `@architect`, design the Contoso Ticketing workload described in the requirement document.

# Expected output

`docs/architecture.md` containing a Mermaid architecture diagram, a resource table with CAF names
and SKU justifications, a security section mapping every security requirement to a design decision,
a Well-Architected trade-off section, and a list of open questions.

# Done when

- Every resource in the requirement document appears in the resource table.
- Every security requirement is explicitly addressed.
- Open questions are listed rather than guessed at.
